eyebrow: SQL Server Performance Tuning · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 14 · Index Tuning in Depth

code:
CREATE INDEX IX_Orders_CustomerId_Covering
    ON dbo.Orders (CustomerId, OrderDate)
    INCLUDE (TotalDue, ShipCity);

Key columns (CustomerId, OrderDate)
  determine sort order, can be seeked

Included columns (TotalDue, ShipCity)
  stored for retrieval only
  cannot be seeked or sorted on
caption: Same statement, very different jobs.

code:
Key columns
  stored at every B-tree level
  (root, intermediate, leaf)

Included columns
  stored ONLY at the leaf level
  can even be nvarchar(max) / xml
  (not allowed as key columns at all)
caption: A narrower tree above, full data below.

steps.sub: must be a key column, correctly ordered

steps.label: Just needs to be read back
